thread.title: Calendar of Events for Friday

author: Matt Harvey
title: Calendar of Events for Friday
text:
Through Oct. 31
Art exhibition at The Gallery, Mondays through Fridays, 10 a.m.-5 p.m., James & Law building, downtown Clarksburg. Artists: Lotus MacDowell: watercolors of landscapes, buildings of the area; Pam Martino: collage mono prints; Beth Keener Flanery: handcrafted handbags; Joel Dugan: murals, oil and acrylic paintings of landscapes, portraits, still lifes, florals and collages. Reception from 1-4 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 3, at James & Law with the artists present to meet the public.
Friday, Oct. 2
Marshville CEOS Hot Dog Sale and Community Yard Sale, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.. Hot dog sale is eat-in or take out. For the yard sale: Everything must go. Deals include baby items, Christmas decorations, women’s clothes, household items and more.
Oct. 2-3
Books & More Sale, Clarksburg-Harrison Public Library. Friday: 11 a.m.-7 p.m.; Saturday: 11 a.m.-2 p.m. Books, home and household items, games, toys and surplus items.
Saturday, Oct. 3
Roosevelt-Wilson Class of 1965 monthly brunch, 11 a.m., FOP Restaurant, Nutter Fort. Alumni, family, friends. 304-266-8071.
Immaculate Conception Church Women’s Retreat for women ages 18 and up. Keynote speaker: renowned author Kimberly Hahn. 8 a.m. Mass in the church, followed by breakfast in the Parish Center, 150 S. Maple Ave. $30 registration fee at https://stpaulcenter.com/events/clarksburg2026. Call 304-622-8243 for more information.
Clarksburg First Fridays Second Annual Taste of Harrison, 1-4 p.m., Jackson Square. Sample from an array of local favorites; each ticket gives six sample opportunities. Tickets are $20 for adults, $10 for children. Also: Car show, 1-4 p.m. at Jackson Square; entry fee is $20. DJ Scott Gum at Jackson Square. Children’s activities at Orpheum Park sponsored by Harrison County Parks and Recreation. Art Gallery open at the James and Law Building on Main Street. Clarksburg History Museum open from 10 a.m.-8 p.m. Harry Powers Ghost Bus Tours at 5 p.m. and 6:30 p.m., leaving from the Clarksburg History Museum. Model Railroad Club open from 11 a.m.-3 p.m. MTN Craft film festival at the Robinson Grand Theater (free all-day event). Downtown restaurants and businesses open. Mike Spatafore, 304-641-5764.
Girls in Aviation Day, 11 a.m.-2 p.m., old North Central WV Airport Terminal, 2000 Aviation Way, Bridgeport. UH-60M Black Hawk helicopter flying; static displays; fire, fuel and snow removal vehicles. Open to children 18 and under, who must be accompanied by an adult. Preregistration required at https://tinyurl.com/s9e6seey.
Sagebrush Round-Up with The Round-Up Band and Nashville recording artist Andy Griggs. Tickets $30 at the door. Doors open at 4 p.m., dinners at 5 p.m., music at 6 p.m. 2580 Bunner Ridge Road, Fairmont.
The West Milford Lions Club car show has been rescheduled to Oct. 18.
Sunday, Oct. 4
Sagebrush Round-Up Car Show. Registration from 11 a.m.-1 p.m.; show from 1-3 p.m. Featuring live music from Flannel and Company. Registration is $15. 2580 Bunner Ridge Road, Fairmont.
Monday, Oct. 5
VFW Post 573 House Committee meeting, gather at 6 p.m., meeting at 7 p.m., at the Post.
United Technical Center Council meeting, 9:30 a.m., 251 Marietta St., Clarksburg.
Tuesday, Oct. 6
Celebrate Recovery at Clarksburg Baptist Church. Tuesdays at 6:30 p.m. Doors open at 6:15 p.m. Bonita Totten, 304-672-1657; Lou Ortenzio, 304-677-8880, louortenzio@gmail.com.
VFW Post 573 Auxiliary meeting, 6:30 p.m. at the Post.
Wednesday, Oct. 7
Lost Creek Senior Citizens Satellite meeting, 11 a.m.-2 p.m., Lost Creek United Methodist Church basement. Lunch is catered. Flu shots will be available.
Thursday, Oct. 8
Roosevelt-Wilson Class of 1957 monthly lunch, noon, FOP Restaurant, Nutter Fort. Alumni, family, friends. 304-566-7397.
Harrison County Democratic Women’s Club meeting, 6 p.m., Vincent Memorial Church, Nutter Fort. Men and independents welcome.
Friday, Oct. 9
Little Lambs Closet Consignment Sale, 9 a.m.-6 p.m., Heritage Christian School, Bridgeport. Shop discounted kids’ gear, clothing and toys. Free admission. Supports local charities.
Saturday, Oct. 10
Gather for Good Dinner & Silent Auction at Best Western Bridgeport, 100 Lodgeville Road, Bridgeport, starting at 5 p.m., with dinner served at 5:30 p.m. Event includes dinner, fellowship, silent auction, student spotlights and HCA leadership message in support of Hillside Christian Academy. Tickets: $55 per person or $300 for a table of six, available exclusively through HCA by calling 304-848-3800.
Little Lambs Closet Consignment Sale, 9 a.m.-1 p.m., Heritage Christian School, Bridgeport. Shop discounted kids’ gear, clothing, and toys. Free admission. Supports local charities.
Sunday, Oct. 11
Free concert for military veterans with Jessica Lynch making an appearance, Robinson Grand Performing Arts Center, Clarksburg. Doors open at 2 p.m.; concert starts at 3 p.m. Guests who aren’t military veterans pay $10. VFW Post 573 will hold a fundraising dinner at the nearby post afterward.
Tuesday, Oct. 13
Stonewall Jackson Civil War Roundtable, 6:30 p.m., Waldomore, 404 W. Pike St., Clarksburg. Guest speaker: Steve French, prize-winning author and Civil War historian, on the topic “McNeill’s Rangers and the Capture of Generals Crook and Kelley, Feb. 21, 1865.” For more information, contact Pete Taylor at 304-476-3298. All are welcome to attend.
Harrison County Association of Retired School Employees luncheon, noon, St. Ann’s Catholic Church, Shinnston. Program Funeral Planning. Bring non-perishable foods for the food pantries. For reservations: call Norma at 304-842-4213 or Mary Ann at 304-592-2061.
Celebrate Recovery at Clarksburg Baptist Church. Tuesdays at 6:30 p.m. Doors open at 6:15 p.m. Bonita Totten, 304-672-1657; Lou Ortenzio, 304-677-8880, louortenzio@gmail.com.
Wednesday, Oct. 14
Lost Creek & Johnstown Lions Clubs’ District Governor’s Night, 6:30 p.m., Lost Creek United Methodist Church, baked steak dinner by Paula Finster & Lost Creek UMC Women of Faith serving. Reservations required: Lion Greg Wriston, 304-203-0544.
Friday, Oct. 16
Hot dog and bake sale, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m., Vincent Memorial UMC, 401 Indiana Ave., Nutter Fort.
Saturday, Oct. 17
Lumberport High School Alumni quarterly meeting, 11 a.m., Lumberport United Methodist Church. Details: 304-826-7390.
West Milford Lions Club annual car show, West Milford Community Center. Registration 1-3 p.m.; car show 3-5 p.m. Registration cost: $15. Dash plaques for first 50 entries. Twelve trophies to be awarded. Multiple raffle baskets; door prizes. Hilda Clutter, 304-745-4778.
Celebrate Missions Fall Craft and Vendor Show, 9 a.m.-3 p.m., Duff Street MultiMinistry Building, 204 Baker Ave., Clarksburg. Hosted by the Duff Street United Women in Faith. Proceeds benefit mission projects.
Mamie’s Closet Clothing and Food Giveaway, 10 a.m.-1 p.m., Kelly Miller Community Center, 408 E.B. Saunders Way, Clarksburg. Meals will be provided. For questions, contact Cathy at 304-476-1434.
Monday, Oct. 19
VFW Post 573 House Committee meeting, gather at 6 p.m., meeting at 7 p.m., at the Post.
Tuesday, Oct. 20
Clarksburg Retired Postal Employees meeting, 9 a.m., IHOP, Bridgeport. 304-624-4262.
Friday, Oct. 30
Military Order of Purple Heart Chapter 418 meeting, noon, IHOP restaurant in White Oaks section of Bridgeport. Commander Porter Southern, 304-584-5906; Senior Vice President Harold Wilson, 304-203-5856.
Monday, Nov. 2
Clarksburg Veterans Day Parade entries due to Meuse-Argonne Post VFW 573. Write to VFW Post 573, 430 W. Pike St., Clarksburg, WV 26301; call 304-622-3591; write vfwpost573@gmail.com; or visit the post’s Facebook site. The parade will be held Nov. 11.
Wednesday, Nov. 11
Veterans Day ceremony by Meuse-Argonne Veterans of Foreign War Post 573 and Auxiliary, 11 a.m., Jackson Square, Clarksburg. Veterans Day parade at noon. Free soup beans and cornbread at the VFW post after the parade.
summary: Model Railroad Club open from 11 a.m.-3 p.m. MTN Craft film festival at the Robinson Grand Theater (free all-day event). Event includes dinner, fellowship, silent auction, student spotlights and HCA leadership message in support of Hillside Christian Academy. Free concert for military veterans with Jessica Lynch making an appearance, Robinson Grand Performing Arts Center, Clarksburg. Guest speaker: Steve French, prize-winning author and Civil War historian, on the topic “McNeill’s Rangers and the Capture of Generals Crook and Kelley, Feb. 21, 1865.” For more information, contact Pete Taylor at 304-476-3298.
